restrictions.menu.blockAdsInfo: Sponsored messages in channels, bots and videos are not loaded
restrictions.menu.contentRestrictionsInf: Bots, channels and messages marked “unavailable on your device” open as usual
restrictions.menu.copyProtectionInfo: Forward, copy and save in protected chats. Forwards are sent as a copy
restrictions.menu.forwardAttributionInfo: The first line of a copy links to the author
restrictions.menu.keepSelfDestructingInf: View-once and timed photos, videos, video messages and voice messages show as ordinary media — no blur, you can save and forward them (as a copy) — and stay in the chat; no timer starts. The sender learns you opened them only if you mark the media as opened in the message menu (press and hold the media in the chat)
restrictions.menu.revealSpoilersInfo: Text and media under spoilers are shown at once
restrictions.menu.screenshotsInfo: Screenshots and screen recording in protected chats; in secret chats the other side is not told about a screenshot
